name: Pour Lords: money older than light

p3.say: No signature. Just a header, same on every ancient page: 'SAMPLE LEDGER — DO NOT SHIP.' We built an empire on a placeholder, and I find that absolutely hilarious and you should too.

p2.say: First entry: fuel futures, sold and settled... dated before the world's first sunrise. Money older than light, friend. The books don't start at the beginning — they start BEFORE it. Someone funded this world like a venture.

p1.say: The investigator returns! You've been good for business and better for gossip, so here's the house secret, on the house. Our oldest account books.

p5.say: Take the page. The Lords always pay debts to people who might end the world — it's just good bookkeeping.

p4ask.say: The Margrave's decanter stands empty beside the impossible ledger. Tradition says a deal this old closes with a drink.
